h1_period_policy: 46..90 proves regular second half; 45 or >90 ambiguous: H2 only, flagged; never infer from FT
eligibility: eligible(); original unedited first version; market Asian Total; valid quarter line; odds>1; sent AND captured after freeze, within 120s of sending; no FT/mark/note known for game; actual capture is decision; no retrospective backfill
tests: H1 minus H2 policy per H2 game at odds*0.98
sequential: Common nonoverlapping H2 chain; next admission only after closure at first observed FT or 72h; e-products 1+0.25*x for positive and 1-0.25*x/B for negative; unresolved outcomes use lower bound for positive and upper bound for negative, never factual settlement; H1/H2 odds haircut 2%; paired clipped policy difference divided by 2; six directions alpha=0.05/6; terminal decision after 30d+72h with >=100 chain games and external publication proof; threshold=120; otherwise INCONCLUSIVO
paired_estimand: profit(H1 first eligible, or 0 if none) minus profit(H2 first eligible); same game once; paired confirmatory contrast clips each policy profit to [-1,1]; uncapped difference descriptive; no causal attribution
failure: Negative direction crosses 120 with >=100 chain games after window+72h and verified history: REJEITADO; neither direction or both: INCONCLUSIVO; no automatic extension
activation: not_installed; requires separately authorized integration; existing certification unchanged
